'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Mike Stirling DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Stirling]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Mike Stirling Dark d2p1_p25.png (2013 form). Light/Dark unchecked; side from
